subject.title: [Feature Request] Auto-linkify URLs in tool output cards (Control UI & WebChat)

question: Should a complete Control UI implementation satisfy this issue, or must native WebChat tool-result cards gain equivalent clickable URL behavior before completion?
rationale: The central Control UI request is bounded, but native WebChat was included conditionally and requires a separate SwiftUI implementation and validation path.

options.title: Control UI first
options.body: Accept complete, safe Control UI coverage and track native WebChat parity separately if it remains desired.

options.title: Require both surfaces
options.body: Keep one acceptance boundary and require equivalent safe link rendering in both Lit and SwiftUI tool-result cards.

recommendation.title: Control UI first
recommendation.body: Accept complete, safe Control UI coverage and track native WebChat parity separately if it remains desired.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced and maintained relevant chat rendering and most recently documented the cross-surface scope and safety tradeoff.
